item.name: 7. Testing Scenarios
Complete Flow Test - Create Form & Simulate Lead

request.description:
# Complete Testing Flow

## Step 1: Setup
1. Set your `JWT_TOKEN`, `USER_ID`, and `BROWSERCLOUD_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in collection variables
2. Ensure your server is running on the configured BASE_URL

## Step 2: Create Lead Form
1. Run: "Create Person Search Lead Form"
2. The `LEAD_FORM_ID` will be automatically saved
3. Verify the form was created by running "Get Lead Form by ID"

## Step 3: Simulate Real-time Lead Detection
1. Run: "Simulate Browsercloud Webhook - Twitter Post"
2. This simulates Browsercloud detecting a matching post
3. The system should:
   - Validate webhook signature
   - Process the social media post
   - Match it against your lead form
   - Create a real-time lead
   - Send WebSocket notification (if connected)
   - Generate AI response suggestion

## Step 4: Retrieve Real-time Leads
1. Run: "Get Real-time Leads by User"
2. Verify the lead was created from the webhook
3. Check the AI-generated response suggestion
4. Review matched keywords and buying signals

## Step 5: Update Lead Status
1. Copy a `lead_id` from the previous response
2. Set it as `LEAD_ID` variable
3. Run: "Update Real-time Lead Status"
4. Mark the lead as contacted with notes

## Step 6: Test Multiple Platforms
1. Run: "Simulate Browsercloud Webhook - LinkedIn Post"
2. Run: "Simulate Browsercloud Webhook - Multiple Posts"
3. Run: "Get Real-time Leads by Platform" for each platform

## Step 7: Monitor System Health
1. Run: "Health Check"
2. Run: "Browsercloud Service Status"
3. Run: "Real-time Processing Metrics"
4. Verify all systems are operational

## Expected Results
- ✅ Lead form created successfully
- ✅ Webhook processed without errors
- ✅ Real-time leads created instantly
- ✅ AI response suggestions generated
- ✅ Lead quality scores calculated
- ✅ Status updates work correctly
- ✅ All health checks pass

## WebSocket Testing (Optional)
1. Use wscat or a WebSocket client
2. Connect to: `wss://your-domain/ws/leads?token={{JWT_TOKEN}}&user_id={{USER_ID}}`
3. Trigger webhook simulation
4. Observe real-time notification

## Performance Expectations (V2 Improvements)
- Lead detection: **Instant** (vs 10-12 hour delay in V1)
- Notification delivery: **< 1 second**
- AI response generation: **2-3 seconds**
- Webhook processing: **< 500ms**
